scope: Internal compiled-engine compatibility; public workflow uses native iOS names.

retained_internal_protocols.name: --android-root
retained_internal_protocols.reason: Hidden import alias and original compiled oracle CLI. The native production help exposes --ios-root.

retained_internal_protocols.name: android_source_anchors / android_source_anchors_ref
retained_internal_protocols.reason: Old-plan import parser and original engine test fixtures retain compatibility. Native public templates and authoring use source_anchors / source_anchors_ref; current profile, lint and index accept them directly.

retained_internal_protocols.name: config.android
retained_internal_protocols.reason: Read-only legacy configuration import and mismatch detection. New native initialization does not create this key.

retained_internal_protocols.name: Original compiled binaries and original toolkit implementation identifiers
retained_internal_protocols.reason: Binary bytes, dispatch IDs, SDK namespaces and original error/rule IDs are preserved. They are internal components, not native source-discovery entry points. Their strings have not been rewritten, encoded or hidden.

retained_internal_protocols.name: Android in the original NON_BIZ exclusion data and paired oracle tests
retained_internal_protocols.reason: Original matching data and test labels retain their meaning so the behavior comparison remains valid.

retained_internal_protocols.name: android_id (read-only UI graph engines)
retained_internal_protocols.reason: Only a temporary four-file view maps the native identity key at the original validator/query boundary. Formal graph and returned JSON use ios_id. Raw original output and both file hash sets are retained. No binary bytes are changed.

retained_internal_protocols.name: Original icon source-density parameters
retained_internal_protocols.reason: Not a native Asset Catalog input API. Pipeline launcher uses original audit/dry-run to reject would-change sets before the original engine, then checks that it did not mutate target code. Explicit source-backed plans may use the original icon_fix before the loop.

retained_internal_protocols.name: capture-android-traffic.md
retained_internal_protocols.reason: Exact string retained by immutable Windows/macOS network helper binaries and a proxy source comment. Safe internal redirect only; public references use capture-ios-traffic.md. Byte search proves the references, not that a process opens the Markdown at runtime; that runtime read has not been proven. No old source commands remain in the redirect.

retained_internal_protocols.name: activity / activity_name / --activity / adb_serial / launcher_activity / resumed / historical name-normalization suffixes
retained_internal_protocols.reason: Normalized input/profile/import slots and original rule data retain exact spellings. Values are actual native identities, not source SDK APIs. Source device/replay support must be evidenced separately; current unadapted source-device paths are DEFERRED, not successful native verification.

validation: Public workflow Markdown/TOML/YAML is checked separately from internal code, test fixtures and opaque binary content. This is not an assertion that every byte in the package lacks legacy platform strings.
known_limits: VERIFY native source routes use selected-product SwiftSyntax facts; HarmonyOS target uses the shared original 1.5.2 engine with SDK-proved static supplements. Tool tests do not establish application VERIFY completion; dynamic/unproved chains remain unknown.
Legacy optional source scanners are not evidence of native coverage. Native source phases use Source, native graph and semantic analysis, not empty foreign scans.

VERIFY/scenario/ad source-device drivers are not claimed native merely by revised instructions. Require an actually available native driver and real replay evidence; otherwise use existing DEFERRED semantics. Vendor snapshots and optional legacy source scanners were not made into Swift analyzers by text changes.
